messages:
alex: heads-up — noticed a persistent latency tail on qwen-15b when RoPE-scaling=1.15 is enabled on nightly. 95th ~320ms, 99th ~470ms for small batches. unclear if kernel selector keeps flipping during generation.

maria: ugh. timeline? repro command? :thinking:

alex: ran this locally on a 48GB A100 replicate:
```
runtest --model qwen-15b --ctx 8192 --batch 4 --prompt-dist short --rope-scale 1.15 --kernels auto --kv-policy aggressive
```
logs show several kernel switches mid-seq:
```
[KERNEL] select: aten_cuBLAS_fused (step 0)
[KERNEL] select: optimized_attention_fwd (step 8)
[KERNEL] evict-kv: triggered (size 1.1GB)
[KERNEL] select: aten_cuBLAS_fused (step 12)
```

alex: also saw kv-cache eviction thrashing when concurrent batch size >6. tail gets worse when prefix hits pile-up.

bench-bot: automated profile summary: qwen-15b | rope=1.15 | batch=4 -> p50 85ms p95 320ms p99 470ms | kernel-switches=3 | kv-evicts=2 | mem-alloc-spikes=true

jay: do we know which ops cause the kernel flip? likely attention kernel fallback due to non-uniform seq-lens.

toni: ran a sweep this morning with two variants:
- disable kernel switching (force aten_cuBLAS_fused) -> p99 down to 230ms, but p50 up 10ms for some long-prefix cases.
- keep switch but tighten batch cap to 4 -> p99 260ms, kv-evicts reduced.

maria: interesting. so heuristic tradeoff: avoid mid-request kernel change vs small wins on throughput for certain sequences.

alex: my take: for qwen-15b with rope-scale >1.1 we should bias selector to stick to one kernel for the lifetime of a request unless there's a hard failure. basically add a hysteresis counter to kernel-selector (require N consecutive steps indicating new kernel before switching).

jay: +1. also add a soft limit on concurrent batches per-allocator for those models to avoid kv-evict thrash. we saw evict when live-kv > 0.85*pool.

maria: can you sketch the config change? small snippet works.

alex: config suggestion (per-model override):
```yaml
models:
  qwen-15b:
    kernel_selector:
      stickiness: 12   # require 12 consecutive votes before switching
      initial_bias: aten_cuBLAS_fused
    batching:
      max_inflight_batches: 4
    kv_cache:
      eviction_threshold: 0.9
      prewarm_fraction: 0.2
```

toni: tested that exact config on staging: p95 180ms p99 240ms, kv-evicts=0 in 1k requests. nice. :rocket:

bench-bot: regression check: for llama-70b (baseline configs) no change in p99; for mixtral-8x no regressions but p50 increased ~6ms.

maria: acceptable if latency tail improves. next: plan canary rollout for qwen routes? propose 5% traffic for 24h with tracing hooks.

alex: +1. add a metric alert if kernel-switch-rate > 0.5 per request or p99 > 300ms. also record a sample trace for any request that crosses a kernel switch.

jay: one more note: rope scaling interacts with kv head dims on Mixtral variants. we should add a preflight that checks estimated kv-memory under rope-scale and refuse high stickiness if estimated memory > 0.95 pool. avoids OOMs.

maria: good call. can you file a tiny RFC? 1-pager + config diff. i'll review.

alex: filing now — link will be in the channel in a minute.

sre-bot: deploy-check queued for canary config. CI: 17/18 checks passed.

toni: I'll run a synthetic long-prefix generator against canary to stress kv and kernel selector overnight.

maria: thanks everyone. nice work isolating the tail. we'll sync tomorrow to decide rollout window. :thumbsup:
